item.scanner:headline: Redomiciles to UK via 1:1 share exchange with Cadeler plc
item.description:
Redomiciles to UK via 1:1 share exchange with Cadeler plc

Announced the launch of a voluntary share exchange offer by Cadeler plc, a new UK-incorporated parent, to exchange each Cadeler share for one Cadeler plc share. Holders of ADSs (each representing 4 shares) will receive 4 Cadeler plc shares per ADS. The offer period runs from 22 September to 21 October 2026, with settlement expected on 29 October 2026. The redomiciliation aims to enhance marketability and attract a broader investor base.

About: Cadeler A/S, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an offshore wind installation vessel contractor in Denmark, the United Kingdom, Germany, Poland, rest of Europe, the United States, and Taiwan. The company engages in the transport and installation of offshore wind turbine generators, foundations, and topsides and substations; maintenance of offshore wind turbine generators, and offshore structures and platforms; and offshore construction within the renewable space.

item.title: 🤝 Merger · Definitive · TLX
item.scanner:headline: Acquires ITM for $1.65B in stock; up to $700M milestones
item.description:
Acquires ITM for $1.65B in stock; up to $700M milestones

Announced a definitive agreement to acquire ITM Isotope Technologies Munich SE, a private radioisotope producer, for $1.65B upfront on a cash-free/debt-free basis. Consideration includes 105.8M Telix shares (valued at $11.841/share, ~$1.25B) plus assumption of $302M net debt and $96M expenses. Additional contingent consideration up to $700M tied to ITM-11 regulatory and sales milestones. The merger is subject to Telix shareholder approval and customary closing conditions; pro forma 2026 revenue expected to exceed $1.3B.

About: Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited, a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, focuses on the development and commercialization of therapeutic and diagnostic radiopharmaceuticals. The company operates through three segments: Precision Medicine, Therapeutics, and Manufacturing Solutions. Its lead therapeutic product candidate is TLX591, a lutetium-labeled radio antibody-drug conjugate (rADC), which is in a Phase 3 clinical trial in patients with advanced prostate cancer.

  • Counterparty: ITM Isotope Technologies Munich SE
  • Deal value: $1.65B upfront (cash-free/debt-free)
  • Consideration: stock
  • Announced: 2026-09-21
  • Next catalyst: Telix shareholder approval vote
